title: Docs and Multilingual Discovery
case_ids_frozen_by: P18 contract-freeze revision; Master Plan supplies requirements, not P18-Txxx identifiers

capabilities.p18_boundary: Docs static rendering/discovery/indexation contribution; P19 owns Website and later G9 contribution, P22 production G13 remains later.

inherited_authorities: P04 signed six-shell authority, specifically the Astro/Starlight static Docs shell and its article/search-open/nav-drawer/not-found/offline-static state boundary
P05-P17 released capability/API evidence as the only source for whether a Docs/API page may claim a capability is released
P17 signed API-key/webhook/Admin completion and zero unresolved DECISION REQUIRED at P18 handoff
P00 capability/route traceability snapshots remain subordinate to the Master Plan and Page-Level IA
capability_contract.scope: P18 closes only the Docs and multilingual discovery contribution to CAP-TECHNICAL-SEO. P19 Website/technical SEO, P20 release-wide gates and P21/P22 native package/install/production validation remain later-owned.

p04_docs_shell_authority.boundary: P18 may extend Docs content/discovery but must not reinterpret the signed P04 shell or claim full G4/G5/G9 closure.

rules: Page-Level IA remains the sole route/path/status/index/canonical/alternate authority.
Only canonical indexable 200 Docs URLs enter a sitemap; DOCS-SEARCH never does.
ALT-DOCS is reciprocal only for published 200 translations; English Docs home supplies x-default.
API docs are indexable/published as released only when current-repository owning capability evidence authorizes that claim.
Indexable Docs primary content is present in initial HTML and cannot be a loading-only client shell.
Content owner and lastUpdated are explicit reviewed content facts.
No fabricated translation route or hreflang target is permitted.
No Docker production guide is permitted.
Native self-hosting documentation may describe approved architecture but cannot misstate P21/P22 release status.
A REQUIRED capability may be described before release only with visible not-released labelling and exclusion from sitemap/internal acquisition links.
API methods and paths are checked against current repository authority rather than copied from legacy documentation.
API Keys and generic outbound Webhooks may be documented as released because their P17 signed G3/G6 authority is inherited; later capabilities remain gated by their own evidence.
Examples use placeholders and never embed production credentials or secret-bearing evidence.
Search supports shortcut, arrow navigation and Escape with focus return.
Language/theme/Workspace controls are keyboard accessible and overlays do not stack.
English and Simplified Chinese long content/code blocks do not create root horizontal overflow.
No pageerror, console error, clipped required content or broken focus is accepted.

later_owned: P19 Website technical SEO and G9 performance
P22 owner-controlled production G13/Search Console evidence

environment_contract.docs_framework: Astro 7.2.2 + Starlight 0.41.7 inherited from P04; versions may change only through reviewed dependency change without changing the static-production boundary

closure.scope_rule: P18 closes only frozen Docs/multilingual discovery and P18 CAP-TECHNICAL-SEO contribution. P19-P22 remain later-owned.

cases.name: Bilingual Docs homes render authoritative raw HTML
cases.oracle: /docs/en/ and /docs/zh-CN/ return indexable 200 static HTML with one visible H1, unique title/description and reviewed META-DOCS fields; no loading-only document is accepted.

cases.name: META-DOCS frontmatter and content ownership contract
cases.oracle: Every publishable document has title, description, locale, lastUpdated, canonical path, translation linkage and content owner; lastUpdated is content authority rather than build time.

cases.name: Docs canonical normalization and query exclusion
cases.oracle: CAN-DOCS derives lowercase canonical URLs from published frontmatter, preserves only the two Docs-home trailing-slash exceptions and never canonicals tracking/search/filter query variants.

cases.name: Reciprocal hreflang and x-default authority
cases.oracle: ALT-DOCS is reciprocal only when both translations return published 200; Docs home provides English x-default and every alternate self-canonicalizes correctly.

cases.name: Untranslated documents do not invent alternates
cases.oracle: An untranslated published article remains a valid locale document without a fabricated hreflang peer, fake translated route or acquisition link.

cases.name: Withdrawn and unknown Docs status semantics
cases.oracle: Known withdrawn Docs return 410, unknown Docs return 404, neither enters sitemap or emits a false canonical/alternate, and no 200 soft-404 is accepted.

cases.name: API reference release-state gating
cases.oracle: DOCS-API returns/publishes 200 only for APIs whose owning capability has released evidence; approved-but-unreleased contracts are visibly not released and excluded from sitemap/acquisition links.

cases.name: English Pagefind index and discovery
cases.oracle: The static English Pagefind index contains only eligible published English Docs, returns relevant deterministic results and excludes noindex/withdrawn/unreleased-only content.

cases.name: Simplified Chinese Pagefind index and discovery
cases.oracle: The static zh-CN Pagefind index contains only eligible published Simplified Chinese Docs and returns locale-correct deterministic results without cross-locale canonical corruption.

cases.name: Docs search route robots and error-state contract
cases.oracle: DOCS-SEARCH stays noindex and outside sitemap/canonical sets; valid queries cover results/empty/offline-static and malformed queries produce 400 rather than a crawlable soft-success page.

cases.name: Pagefind keyboard and privacy interaction contract
cases.oracle: Search supports the documented shortcut, arrow-key navigation and Escape close/focus return; no default personalized search tracking is emitted.

cases.name: Breadcrumb, ToC and previous-next navigation integrity
cases.oracle: Published articles expose route-correct breadcrumbs, heading-derived ToC and deterministic previous/next links without links to withdrawn, unknown or unreleased-only pages.

cases.name: Docs sidebar graph and orphan-page prevention
cases.oracle: Every indexable Docs page has at least one crawlable internal parent and every published article/API page is reachable from the locale navigation graph; orphan count is zero.

cases.name: Locale sitemap children and lastmod authority
cases.oracle: Docs EN and zh-CN sitemap children contain only canonical indexable 200 pages, API pages only after release, and lastmod comes from the content record rather than build time.

cases.name: Broken-link and static-asset integrity
cases.oracle: The complete published Docs graph has zero broken internal links/assets and external references are syntax/allowlist checked without turning network availability into false product authority.

cases.name: Code-block correctness and prohibited-production guidance guard
cases.oracle: Executable/checkable code blocks pass syntax or contract validation where applicable and no Docker/Compose/PM2/Node production runtime guide is published.

cases.name: Native self-hosting guide accuracy without premature release claims
cases.oracle: Native self-hosting documentation reflects Nginx, PHP installer boundary, eight systemd services, MySQL/Redis/ClamAV/local-storage architecture while clearly separating P21/P22 unreleased install/package completion from approved contract.

cases.name: API source checking and secret-safe examples
cases.oracle: Published API reference methods/paths/scopes match checked current-repository route authority and examples use placeholders/redaction rather than real credentials, tokens, webhook secrets or API keys.

cases.name: Inherited P04 Docs shell remains authoritative
cases.oracle: P18 extends the signed P04 Astro/Starlight static Docs shell without replacing Design System tokens or its article/search-open/nav-drawer/not-found/offline-static state boundary.

cases.name: Docs accessibility interaction matrix
cases.oracle: Docs navigation, search, language/theme controls, article headings, code controls and focus order satisfy keyboard/name-role-value/visible-focus/zoom/reduced-motion requirements for the P18-applicable G5 subset.

cases.name: Docs responsive browser matrix
cases.oracle: English and zh-CN representative Docs states pass canonical desktop/tablet/mobile viewports plus 320 CSS px reflow with no horizontal overflow, clipped required text, pageerror or console error.

cases.name: Static build and production-runtime boundary
cases.oracle: Docs build is deterministic static output with primary content in initial HTML; Node/Pagefind are build-time only and no Node HTTP/SSR/PM2 runtime is introduced into production guidance or deployment authority.

cases.name: G7 Docs crawler and raw-HTTP conformance
cases.oracle: Crawler/raw-HTTP evidence proves metadata, canonical, reciprocal hreflang, status, internal links, sitemap membership, structured-data eligibility and noindex rules for the complete P18 Docs route family.

cases.name: Deterministic content manifest and locale parity ledger
cases.oracle: A machine-readable content manifest accounts for every Docs route, locale, translation linkage, owner, release state, sitemap state and source digest with zero ambiguous or duplicate canonical ownership.

cases.name: P18 exact-head evidence coherence
cases.oracle: P18-T001..P18-T024 evidence, required workflow artifacts and inherited authorities are bound to one exact candidate SHA; mixed-head, stale, missing, malformed or secret-bearing evidence fails closed.

cases.name: P18 accountable exact-head closure
cases.oracle: P18-T001..P18-T025 PASS, applicable exact-head regression matrix is complete, P0/P1/DECISION REQUIRED are 0/0/0, accountable review is signed as a review-only child, and only then merge_authoritative=true.
cases.owner: SEO Owner + Frontend Lead + QA Lead
